stem:
The reproduction rates of citrus rust mites are shown.

| Average Number of Eggs Produced per Day | Temperature |
|-----------------------------------------|-------------|
| 4.20                                    | 30 ºC       |
| 1.20                                    | 16 ºC       |

Based on the information provided, which statement **BEST** describes the effect of temperature on the citrus rust mite?

options.label: A
options.text: Temperature can affect the size of its egg.

options.label: B
options.text: Temperature can influence the gender of its offspring.

options.label: C
options.text: Temperature can affect its rate of reproductive success.

options.label: D
options.text: Temperature can influence the availability of nutrients.
